core.label: Core Courses
core.notes: All courses all compulsory. Students who have already taken H0H51A 'Elasticiteits- en plasticiteitsleer', do not take H03Y1A 'Theory of Elasticity and Plasticity', but take an additional course(s) with the same number of credits within the elective courses.

coreChoice.label: Core Choice
coreChoice.notes: One of both courses is compulsory. Students who have already taken one of the following courses (H08U4A 'Systeemtheorie', H01M8A 'Systeemtheorie en regeltechniek', X0B91A 'Systeemtheorie en regeltechniek', X9X15A 'Systeemtheorie', H09B8A 'Systeembenadering van unicellulaire organismen') choose H04X3A 'Control Theory', other students choose H04X3B 'Systems and Control Theory'.

generalInterest.label: General Interest / Broadening
generalInterest.notes: Students choose at least 12 and at most 14 credits from the following list of general interest courses (1 course from part A and at least 1 course from part B) Exception: students who have chosen the Module Manufacturing & Management, do NOT take 12-14 credits from this list, but take 1 course from part A and 1 course from part B. One of the three courses 'Religions' H0N82A or 'Religie, zingeving en levensbeschouwing' A04D5A / A08C4A is compulsory. Students who already successfully completed a course with the same content before starting this programme, have to take another 3 ECTS general interest course instead. H04X2A 'Project Management' can only be taken up in conjunction with the 'Master's Thesis' H09Z9A. Students choose either H09Q1A 'Leadership and Strategic Management' or H09P4A 'Engineering and Entrepreneurship'. Students may take maximum 9 credit points of the courses Industrial Experience, Industrial Internship, H0T39A 'Entrepreneurship in de praktijk/in practice' and H0T91A 'Entrepreneurship in practice/service-learning'. Students select, with approval, at most one of the following two courses: H0T39A 'Entrepreneurship in practice' and H0T91A 'Entrepreneurship in practice/service-learning'.
